title: The AUSSS website guide
subtitle: Every page of ausss-ainshams.org and every part of the members portal, with a picture of each and how to use it.

parts.title: Getting around
parts.blurb: What is on every page: the header and its menus, the footer, the two themes, and how the site reshapes itself on a phone.

parts.title: The public pages
parts.blurb: The pages anybody can open, one chapter each: what a visitor finds there and what they can do.

parts.title: The portal for every member
parts.blurb: Signing in, and what every member has once they are in: the dashboard, their profile, tasks, updates and notifications.

parts.title: The portal for officers
parts.blurb: What an officer runs for a committee or a support division: its page, its events, its open calls and members, and the editors that belong to one division each.

parts.title: The portal for the Executive Board
parts.blurb: The society's own records and switches: the membership roster, verification, what the public forms send in, the shop, the site's wording and the turn of a term.

parts.title: Appendix
parts.blurb: Who can see and do what, every switch in one list, and where to turn when something is not in this guide.
